stream with fresh inputs. Each instance is a separate conversation: the next one
starts without this one's messages.

each demo request. An instance is over when a submission is correct or when the attempt

many submissions and demo requests it used. Feedback on a submission is only
correct/incorrect. There is no way to abandon an instance, and finish is refused until

def solve(g):

    P=5
    # build color cell sets (exclude separator lines: rows/cols that are all sep)
    def cells_col(c): return [(r,c) for r in range(H) if g[r][c]!=sep]
    def cells_row(r): return [(r,c) for c in range(W) if g[r][c]!=sep]
    out=[row[:] for row in g]
    for c in range(10):
        if c==sep: continue
        pts=[(r,r%P)%P,(r,c) for r,c in [(r,c) for r in range(H) for c in range(W)] if g[r][c]==c]
        # occurrences: group by ((r,P-r0?)... use (r%P, c%P) as key; need reference origin: sep lines at multiples of P -> offsets relative to sep line below/above?
        # instead: canonical offset = position within its own 5x5 block: (r//P*P + (r%P), c//P*P + (c%P)) -> just (r%P,c%P) plus which quadrant (which sep-block it's in).
        groups={}
        for r,cc in [(rr2,ccc2) for rr2,ccc2 in pts]: pass
        for r,cc in [(r,cc) for r,cc in [(r2,cc2) for r2 in range(H) for cc2 in range(W) if g[r2][cc2]==c]]:
            groups.setdefault((r%P,cc%P),[]).append((r,cc))
        best=None
        for (or_,oc_),lst in groups.items():
            if not best or len(lst)>best['n']: best={'offs':(or_,oc_),'n':len(lst),'pos':(r-P*(r//P)*P if False else 0)}
        # tile = cells at offsets relative to (best offs)
        or_,oc_=next(iter(groups))
        ref=min((r,cc) for r,cc in groups[(or_,oc_)])
        h=max(r for r,cc in groups.values())-ref[0]+1
        w=max(cc for r,cc in groups.values())-ref[1]+1
        tile=[[1]*w for _ in range(h)]
        for (r,cc) in groups[(or_,oc_)]: tile[r-ref[0]][cc-ref[1]]=c
        # stamp into every quadrant aligned by (or_,oc_)
        for qr in range(P):
            for qc in range(P):
                for i in range(h):
                    for j in range(w):
                        r=qr*P+or_+i; cc=qc*P+oc_+j
                        if 0<=r<H and 0<=cc<W: out[r][cc]=c
    return out

    t=open(d+'/../../sessions/'+os.path.basename(d)+'.jsonl').read().replace('\\n','\n'); G={}

pts=defaultdict(list)
sep=S[0][0]
for r,c in [(i,j) for i in range(4) for j in range(4)]:

for col,(r,c) in [([None],[None])]: pass
print({col:(min(r for r,c in cs), min(c for r,c in cs)) for col,cs in pts.items()})
# where does output place each color in first quadrant?

# So winner = 2 whose original cells were { (1,1),(1,2),(2,0),(2,1),(2,2),(3,1)} → offsets exactly those! And it REPLACED everything else in quad. So rule: fill ENTIRE quadrant (period cell) with the DOMINANT shape's tile (all its cells stamped everywhere), overwrite other shapes.

def solve(g):
    H=len(g);W=len(g[0]);sep=g[0][0];P=5
    pts={(r,c) for r in range(H) for c in range(W) if g[r][c]!=sep}
    bycol={}
    for (r,c) in pts: bycol.setdefault(g[r][c],[]).append((r,c))
    colv=list(bycol.keys())
    # dominant shape: largest count
    dom=max(bycol,key=lambda col:len(bycol[col]))
    cs=[(r,c) for r,c in pts if g[r][c]==dom]
    r0=min(r for r,c in cs); c0=min(c for r,c in cs)
    hh=max(r for r,c in cs)-r0+1; ww=max(c for r,c in cs)-c0+1
    tile=[[dom]*ww for _ in range(hh)]
    for r,c in cs: tile[r-r0][c-c0]=dom
    out=[row[:] for row in g]
    for qr in range(P):
        for qc in range(P):
            orr=qr*P+(r0%P); occ=qc*P+(c0%P)
            for i in range(hh):
                for j in range(ww):
                    r2=orr+i; c2=occ+j
                    if 0<=r2<H and 0<=c2<W:
                        out[r2][c2]=tile[i][j]
    return out
for p in (1,2):
    S=G[f'Demo pair {p} input']; O=G[f'Demo pair {p} output']
    print(p, solve(S)==O)
res=solve(G['Test input']); print(json.dumps(res))

import os,re
def load():
    d=os.path.normpath(os.environ['RLM_SESSION_DIR'])
    t=open(d+'/../../sessions/'+os.path.basename(d)+'.jsonl').read().replace('\\n','\n'); G={}
    for m in re.finditer(r'(Demo pair \d+ (?:input|output)|Test input) \((\d+)x(\d+)\):\n',t):
        k,h,w=m[1],int(m[2]),int(m[3])
        rows=[r.split() for r in t[m.end():].split('\n')[:h]]
        if k not in G and all(len(r)==w and all(x.isdigit() for x in r) for r in rows):
            G[k]=[[int(x) for x in r] for r in rows]
    return G
G=load(); print(sorted(G))
def analyze(pair,i,in_name,out_name):
    A=G[in_name];B=G[out_name];H,W=len(A),len(A[0])
    # separators: full rows/cols of one nonzero color
    cnt=collections.Counter(x for r in A for x in r)
    sep=set(cnt.items())
    S_r=[r for r in range(H) if len(set(A[r]))==1 and A[r][0]!=0]
    S_c=[c for c in range(W) if len({A[r][c] for r in range(H)})==1 and A[0][c]!=0]
    def band(n,lines):
        lo=0;out=[];last=-1
        for x in lines+[n]:
            if x-last-1>=1: out.append((lo,x-1)); last=x
        return out
    rb=band(H,S_r);cb=band(W,S_c)
    print('pairs',i,'dims',H,W,'rb',rb,'cb',cb)
    # per color: native S in its home band (first occurrence), and tile T = pattern appearing in its own band in output
    out=B
    for c in collections.Counter(x for r in A for x in r):
        if c in (set(S_r):set()): continue
        pts=[(r,q) for r in range(H) for q in range(W) if A[r][q]==c]
        if not pts: continue
        hb=max(rb,key=lambda b:min(p[0] for p in pts if b[0]<=p[0]<=b[1]))
        wb=max(cb,key=lambda b:min(p[1] for p in pts if b[0]<=p[1]<=b[1]))
        Sr,Ss=rb[hb],cb[wb]
        # home S
        S=[(r-Sr[0],q-Ss[0]) for r,q in pts if Sr[0]<=r<=Sr[1] and Ss[0]<=q<=Ss[1]]
        # tile from output in the home band×quad
        Tcells=[(r-Sr[0],q-Ss[0]) for r in range(Sr[0],Sr[1]+1) for q in range(Ss[0],Ss[1]+1) if B[r][q]==c]
        res={'color':c,'band_r':Sr,'band_c':Ss,'home_S':sorted(S),'home_T':sorted(Tcells)}
        print(c,res)

import os,re,collections,json
def load():
    d=os.path.normpath(os.environ['RLM_SESSION_DIR'])
    t=open(d+'/../../sessions/'+os.path.basename(d)+'.jsonl').read().replace('\\n','\n'); G={}
    for m in re.finditer(r'(Demo pair \d+ (?:input|output)|Test input) \((\d+)x(\d+)\):\n',t):
        k,h,w=m[1],int(m[2]),int(m[3])
        rows=[r.split() for r in t[m.end():].split('\n')[:h]]
        if k not in G and all(len(r)==w and all(x.isdigit() for x in r) for r in rows):
            G[k]=[[int(x) for x in r] for r in rows]
    return G
G=load(); print(sorted(G))

    cnt=collections.Counter(x for r in A for x in r)
    sep=max(S_r,key=lambda r:cnt[A[r][0]]) if S_r else max(S_c,key=lambda c:cnt[A[0][c]])
    seeds=[(r,q,A[r][q]) for r in range(H) for q in range(W) if A[r][q]!=0 and A[r][q]!=sep]
    out=[[sep]*W if r in S_r else ([A[r][S_c[0]]] if False else [0]*W)[0] for r in range(H)]

def f2(A):
    H,W=len(A),len(A[0])
    S_r=[r for r in range(H) if len(set(A[r]))==1 and A[r][0]!=0]
    S_c=[c for c in range(W) if len({A[r][c] for r in range(H)})==1 and A[0][c]!=0]
    def band(n,lines):
        lo=0;out=[];last=-1
        for x in lines+[n]:
            if x-last-1>=1: out.append((lo,x-1)); last=x
        return out
    rb=band(H,S_r);cb=band(W,S_c)
    cnt=collections.Counter(x for r in A for x in r)
    sep=max(S_r,key=lambda r:cnt[A[r][0]]) if S_r else max(S_c,key=lambda c:cnt[A[0][c]])
    res=[[0]*W for _ in range(H)]
    for r in S_r: res[r]=[sep]*W
    for c_ in S_c:

    seeds=[(r,q,col) for r in range(H) for q in range(W) if A[r][q]!=0 and A[r][q]!=sep]

    for col in set(c for _,_,col in seeds):
        pts=[(r,q) for r,q,col2 in seeds if col2==col]
        hbb=min(range(len(rb)),key=lambda bi:min(p[0] for p in pts if rb[bi][0]<=p[0]<=rb[bi][1]))
        wbb=min(range(len(cb)),key=lambda bi:min(p[1] for p in pts if cb[bi][0]<=p[1]<=cb[bi][1]))
        Sr,Ss=rb[hbb]; Tcells=[(r-Sr[0],q-Ss[0]) for r,q in pts if Sr[0]<=r<=Sr[1] and Ss[0]<=q<=Ss[1]]
        for i in range(len(rb)):
            for j in range(len(cb)):
                for a,b in Tcells:
                    r_,q_=rb[i][0]+a,cb[j][0]+b
                    res[r_][q_]=col
    return res

def f(A):
    H,W=len(A),len(A[0])
    S_r=[r for r in range(H) if len(set(A[r]))==1 and A[r][0]!=0]
    S_c=[c for c in range(W) if len({A[r][c] for r in range(H)})==1 and A[0][c]!=0]
    cnt=collections.Counter(x for r in A for x in r)
    sep=max(S_r,key=lambda r:cnt[A[r][0]]) if S_r else max(S_c,key=lambda c:cnt[A[0][c]])
    rb=bands(H,S_r);cb=bands(W,S_c)
    out=[[0]*W for _ in range(H)]
    for r in S_r: out[r]=[sep]*W
    for c_ in S_c:
        for rr in range(H): out[rr][c_]=sep
    seeds=[(r,q,A[r][q]) for r in range(H) for q in range(W) if A[r][q]!=0 and A[r][q]!=sep]
    colors=set(col for _,_,col in seeds)
    for col in sorted(colors):
        pts=[(r,q) for r,q,col2 in seeds if col2==col]
        hbb=min(range(len(rb)),key=lambda bi:any(rb[bi][0]<=p[0]<=rb[bi][1] for p in pts))
        wbb=min(range(len(cb)),key=lambda bi:any(cb[bi][0]<=p[1]<=cb[bi][1] for p in pts))
        Sr,Ss=rb[hbb],cb[wbb]
        Tk=[(r-Sr[0],q-Ss[0]) for r,q in pts if Sr[0]<=r<=Sr[1] and Ss[0]<=q<=Ss[1]]
        for i in range(len(rb)):
            for j in range(len(cb)):
                for a,b in Tk:
                    r_,q_=rb[i][0]+a,cb[j][0]+b
                    out[r_][q_]=col
    return out
for i in [1,2]:
    R=f(G[f'Demo pair {i} input']);E=G[f'Demo pair {i} output']
    print('demo',i,'match:',R==E)
T=f(G['Test input'])
print(json.dumps(T))
